# Format Date/Time String

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Format a fixed time of 90,061 seconds from the FROG Timestamp epoch (January 1, 1904). UTC formatting gives 1904-01-02 01:01:01 on every computer without reading the clock.

## What this example demonstrates

Format a fixed time of 90,061 seconds from the FROG Timestamp epoch (January 1, 1904). UTC formatting gives 1904-01-02 01:01:01 on every computer without reading the clock.
